description:
Red + yellow = orange?! Bloop the jelly blob mixes colors and changes color every time. A color mixing song for kids.
Kids learn the secondary colors: red + yellow = orange, blue + yellow = green, red + blue = purple, then stir, shake and splash along. Ages 2-6.

LYRICS
Mix, mix, mix the colors!
Swirl them round and see!
Two colors make a new one,
Mix the colors with me!
Red and yellow, swirl, swirl, swirl,
What do we get? Orange, hooray!
Orange like a pumpkin, orange like the sun,
Mixing colors is so much fun!
Blue and yellow, swirl, swirl, swirl,
What do we get? Green, hooray!
Green like a froggy, green like a tree,
Green, green, green for me!
Stir, stir, stir the paint!
Shake, shake, shake it up!
Splash, splash, splash, hooray!
Colors everywhere today!
Red and blue, swirl, swirl, swirl,
What do we get? Purple, hooray!
Purple like grapes, purple like a plum,
Bloop is purple, yum, yum, yum!
Orange, green and purple! Bye-bye!

Orange,
green and purple!

title: Why Is the Sky Blue? Science Song for Kids with Gizmo
description:
Why is the sky blue? Gizmo the robot explains it with a song: sunlight is made of all the rainbow colors, and blue light bounces around the sky the most.
Kids also learn why sunsets look red and orange. Bounce like blue light and zoom like sunlight! Ages 3-6.

LYRICS
Why is the sky blue? Do you know?
Sunlight hides a rainbow glow!
Blue light bounces all around,
That's why the sky is blue, wow, wow!
Sunlight looks white, but guess what's true,
It's red and orange, yellow, green and blue!
All the colors hide inside,
Sunlight takes them for a ride!
When sunlight zooms into the air,
Blue light bounces everywhere!
Bounce, bounce, bounce across the sky,
Blue, blue, blue way up high!
At sunset, light goes a long, long way,
Red and orange come out to play!
Pink and orange in the evening sky,
Then the stars say, goodnight, bye-bye!
Bounce like blue light, bounce, bounce, bounce!
Zoom like sunlight, zoom, zoom, zoom!
Stretch up high and touch the sky!
Wave to the sun, bye-bye!
Why is the sky blue? Now you know! Bye-bye!
bye, bye
Why is the sky blue?
you know! Bye-bye!
Do you know?
Now you know, now you know, bye, bye

title: Yes Yes Fruit Salad Song for Kids! | Fruity Friends
description:
Yes, yes, fruit salad! Make a yummy fruit salad with Pipkiko and the Fruity Friends: wash your hands, peel the banana, add strawberries, oranges and grapes.
A healthy eating song for kids: fruits have vitamins that help you grow. Stir, shake and dance along! Ages 2-5.

LYRICS
Yes, yes, fruit salad, yes, yes, yum!
Chop, chop, mix, mix, here they come!
Apples, bananas, grapes so sweet,
Yes, yes, fruit salad, time to eat!
Wash your hands, scrub, scrub, scrub,
Now we're ready, rub-a-dub!
Banana, peel it, slice it thin,
Yes, yes, toss it in!
Strawberries, red, in they go,
Orange slices, in a row!
Purple grapes, one, two, three,
Yes, yes, fruit for me!
Stir it round, round, round!
Stir it up and down!
Shake your hips and shake your hands,
Fruit salad dance, the best in the land!
Fruits have vitamins to help you grow,
Strong and happy, head to toe!
Share a bowl with all your friends,
Yes, yes, the yummy end!
Yes, yes, fruit salad! See you tomorrow!

title: Where Is My Mama? Baby Animals Song for Kids with Milo
description:
Where is my mama? Milo helps baby animals on the savanna find their mamas: a lion cub, a baby elephant, a baby giraffe, a zebra foal and a baby hippo.
Real facts for kids: baby giraffes can stand up within about an hour of being born, zebra foals learn their mama's stripe pattern, and baby hippos stay close to mama in the water. Ages 2-6.

LYRICS
Where is my mama? Where can she be?
Milo will help you, come with me!
Look high, look low, look all around,
Where is my mama? Mama is found!
Little lion cub says roar,
Where's my mama? I want more!
There she is, the lioness,
Big warm hug, she loves me best!
Little elephant, toot, toot, toot,
Where's my mama? Look, there's her foot!
Mama's trunk gives a gentle hug,
Snuggle close, so warm and snug!
Little giraffe, so new and small,
Where's my mama, very tall?
Look up high, there's mama's face,
Baby giraffes can stand up in an hour, what a race!
Little zebra knows her mama's stripes,
Every pattern is just right!
Baby hippos stay close, dash, dash!
Look high, look low, look left, look right!
Clap your hands, hug someone tight!
Mamas and babies, two by two,
Mama loves me, I love you!
Mama is found! Bye-bye, friends!
Where is my mama?
Where can she be?
Mama is found!
Bye-bye, friends!

title: Hush Little Bunny 🌙 Lullaby for Babies & Kids | Moonbeam
description:
Hush, Little Bunny, a soft bedtime lullaby for babies and kids. Little bunny hops to bed while the owl hoots, Teddy yawns and the stars blink.
Gentle music box and piano with slow breathing to help little ones relax and fall asleep. Ages 0-6.

LYRICS
Hush, little bunny, close your eyes,
Moon is rising in the skies,
Soft and cozy, safe and warm,
Hush, little bunny, sleep till morn.
Little bunny hops to bed,
Fluffy pillow for her head,
Ears fold down and paws tuck in,
Sleepy dreams are soon to begin.
Owl says hoo from the tall oak tree,
Teddy yawns so sleepily,
Little lamb curls up in a ball,
Goodnight, goodnight, to one and all.
Breathe in slow, like a gentle breeze,
Breathe out slow, through the sleepy trees,
Wiggle your toes and let them rest,
Snuggle in, you're loved the best.
Stars are blinking, one, two, three,
Night light glowing, soft for me,
Mama sings a lullaby,
Hush now, hush now, close your eyes.
Hush, little bunny. Goodnight.

title: Big Truck vs Little Truck! Opposites Song for Kids
description:
Big truck vs little truck! Learn opposites with Bolt the fire truck and his friends in Tiny Truck Town: big and little, fast and slow, up and down, loud and quiet.
Kids act out every opposite: stretch up big, crouch down little, run fast and move slow. Ages 2-6.

LYRICS
Big truck, little truck, here we go!
Fast truck, slow truck, high and low!
Opposites, opposites, sing with me,
Big and little, one, two, three!
The fire truck is big, big, big!
The police car is little, zig-zig-zig!
Big goes boom, and little goes beep,
Big and little, side by side we keep!
Zoom, zoom, fast truck, zooming by!
Slow, slow, slow truck, wave goodbye!
Up goes the ladder, high, high, high!
Down goes the ladder, low, bye-bye!
Stretch up big, big, big!
Crouch down little, little, little!
Run in place so fast, fast, fast!
Now move slow, slow, slow at last!
Loud truck, honk, honk, honk!
Quiet truck, shh, tip-toe, tonk!
Opposites are fun to find,
Big and little, every kind!
Big and little! Bye-bye, trucks!
little truck, here we go!
Big and little, side by side

title: Where Is Bloop? Rainbow Hide and Seek Song for Kids
description:
Where is Bloop? Play rainbow hide and seek with Bloop the jelly blob! He hides in red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple, and changes color every time.
A peekaboo color song for kids: cover your eyes, count to three and find Bloop. Ages 2-5.

LYRICS
Where is Bloop? Where can he be?
Hiding in the rainbow, one, two, three!
Peekaboo, peekaboo, look and see,
Where is Bloop? Find him with me!
Is he hiding in the red? Red, red, red!
Peekaboo, there's Bloop's red head!
Is he hiding in the orange? Look, look, look!
Peekaboo, by the orange book!
Is he hiding in the yellow sun?
Peekaboo, yellow, this is fun!
Is he hiding in the green, green grass?
Peekaboo, green, found him fast!
Cover your eyes, one, two, three!
Open them wide, what do you see?
Peekaboo! Clap, clap, clap!
Peekaboo! Tap, tap, tap!
Is he hiding in the blue, blue sky?
Peekaboo, blue, way up high!
Is he hiding in the purple flower?
Peekaboo, purple, rainbow power!
Peekaboo! Bye-bye, rainbow friends!

title: Gizmo Makes a Rainbow! Science Song for Kids
description:
Gizmo makes a rainbow! A science experiment song for kids: put a glass of water in the sunlight and a little rainbow appears.
Kids learn that sunlight holds all the colors and water bends the light to spread them out, just like raindrops do in the sky. Ages 3-6.

LYRICS
Gizmo makes a rainbow, look, look, look!
Sunlight and water, that's all it took!
Red, orange, yellow, green and blue,
Rainbow, rainbow, I made you!
Fill a glass with water, clear and bright,
Put it in the sunny light!
Look at the wall, what do we see?
A little rainbow, wow, whee!
Sunlight looks white, but it's hiding a show,
All the colors in a row!
Water bends the light, and then,
The colors spread out, count them again!
After the rain, when the sun comes out,
Look for a rainbow, round about!
Raindrops bend the light up high,
Painting a rainbow across the sky!
Arms up high, make a rainbow arch!
Sway to the left, then side to side!
Clap for red and stomp for blue,
Wiggle for purple, rainbow you!
Rainbow science! Bye-bye, friends!

title: Can You Guess the Fruit? Peekaboo Song for Kids
description:
Can you guess the fruit? Play peekaboo with Pipkiko and the Fruity Friends: listen to the clues about color and shape, then guess banana, strawberry, orange or grapes.
A guessing game song that builds vocabulary and listening skills. Ages 2-5.

LYRICS
Peekaboo, peekaboo, guess the fruit!
Who is hiding? Toot, toot, toot!
Look at the color, look at the shape,
Can you guess? Is it a grape?
I am yellow, long and bright,
Peel me down and take a bite!
Peekaboo, who can it be?
It's banana! Yes, it's me!
I am red with seeds outside,
Juicy, sweet, I cannot hide!
It's strawberry! Yes, it's me!
Cover your eyes, peek, peek, peek!
Open them up, what do you seek?
Point to the fruit, one, two, three,
Peekaboo, it's fruity time with me!
I am round and orange too,
Squeeze me into juice for you!
Small and purple, round and sweet,
Orange and grapes, a yummy treat!
Peekaboo, fruity friends! See you tomorrow!

title: Milo Had a Zoo! E-I-E-I-O Animal Song for Kids
description:
Milo had a zoo, E-I-E-I-O! A safari twist on Old MacDonald with Milo and his animal friends: a lion, an elephant, a giraffe, a zebra and a hippo.
Kids sing the animal sounds and act them out: roar, toot, munch, neigh and splash! Ages 2-6.

LYRICS
Milo had a zoo, E-I-E-I-O!
And at the zoo he had some friends, E-I-E-I-O!
With a roar, roar here, and a toot, toot there,
And at the zoo he had a lion, E-I-E-I-O!
With a roar, roar here, and a roar, roar there,
Here a roar, there a roar, everywhere a roar, roar,
And at the zoo he had an elephant, E-I-E-I-O!
With a toot, toot here, and a toot, toot there,
Here a toot, there a toot, everywhere a toot, toot,
And at the zoo he had a giraffe, E-I-E-I-O!
With a munch, munch here, and a munch, munch there,
Tall, tall neck, eating leaves up high,
And at the zoo he had a zebra, E-I-E-I-O!
With a neigh, neigh here, and a stripe, stripe there,
And a hippo too, with a splash, splash, splash,
Roar like a lion, E-I-E-I-O!
Toot like an elephant, E-I-E-I-O!
Munch like a giraffe, neigh like a zebra,
Splash like a hippo, here we go!
E-I-E-I-O! Bye-bye, friends!

title: Goodnight Little Animals 🌙 Lullaby for Babies | Moonbeam
description:
Goodnight, Little Animals, a calm lullaby for babies and kids. Say goodnight to the bunny, the lamb, Luna the owl and Teddy as the moon glows and the stars twinkle.
Fun fact: owls stay awake at night! Soft music box and piano with slow breathing to help little ones fall asleep. Ages 0-6.

LYRICS
Goodnight, little animals, goodnight,
The moon is glowing, soft and bright,
Close your eyes and snuggle tight,
Goodnight, little animals, goodnight.
Goodnight, little bunny, in your burrow deep,
Fold your ears and go to sleep,
Goodnight, little lamb, on the soft green hill,
The night is quiet, calm and still.
Owls stay up when the stars come out,
Luna says hoo, then flies about,
Teddy bear yawns, a great big yawn,
Sleep until the morning dawn.
Breathe in slow, like the evening breeze,
Breathe out slow, through the sleepy trees,
Rest your arms and rest your toes,
Close your eyes, and off it goes.
All the friends are tucked in bed,
Pillows soft for every head,
Stars are watching, twinkle, twink,
Sweet dreams now, I think, I think.
Goodnight, little animals. Goodnight.

title: Zoo Freeze Dance! Animal Dance Song for Kids with Milo
description:
Zoo Freeze Dance! Dance like the animals with Milo, then freeze like a statue: stomp like a lion, swing like an elephant, sway like a giraffe, gallop like a zebra and splash like a hippo.
A brain break and movement song that builds listening skills. Ages 2-6.

3D characters made with Meshy AI.

LYRICS
Dance, dance, dance at the zoo,
Then freeze like a statue, one, two!
Wiggle and jiggle, wait for the cue,
Freeze! Can you freeze like me and you?
The lion dances, shake your mane,
Stomp, stomp, stomp, now do it again!
Roar, roar, dance with me,
Freeze! Like a statue, one, two, three!
The elephant dances, swing your trunk,
Step, step, step, funky monk!
Toot, toot, dance with me,
The giraffe dances, stretch up tall,
Sway, sway, sway, don't you fall!
Munch, munch, dance with me,
The zebra dances, gallop, go!
The hippo dances, splash, splash, slow!
Neigh and splash, dance with me,
Faster, faster, everybody spin!
Slower, slower, now tuck in!
Jump up high, then touch the ground,
Freeze! Don't make a single sound!
Freeze! Bye-bye, friends!
Freeze, bye, bye, friends
